items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Luther Henderson and Dudley Brooks were two of our chief arrangers on staff at Great Lakes. ... Luther – Luke, I used to call him

ctx.x: Luther Henderson and Dudley Brooks were two of our chief arrangers on staff at Great Lakes. Of course Dudley Brooks had been ensconced in the Hollywood scene, so he was doing a lot of writing for movies, etc., in Hollywood, but Luther – Luke, I used to call him – he’s an East Coaster. He’d been writing a lot – he’s a piano player, and Dudley’s also a piano player – he had been writing a lot for people on the East Coast. As a matter of fact I saw Luther two weeks ago. He came someplace where I was. Someplace where…
